evidence.name: Screen field: Restore link line spacing
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Restore link line spacing" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Restore link line spacing
sections.description: Sets the vertical space between lines of the restore text. The link is almost always one short line, so this usually has no visible effect — leave it at the default. Only raise it slightly if your custom restore text wraps to multiple lines and the lines look crowded.
